---
title: "Example Docs"
---

This is the umbrella documentation site for a fictional product family.
Its search box finds pages here and in the two product sites.

Try searching for these words. Apart from this list, each of the first
three appears on exactly one site:

- **umbrella** — this site only.
- **lighthouse** — Product A's collector guide.
- **tidepool** — Product B's chart reference.
- **install** — every site has an installation page; results are
  grouped by page and labelled with the site they come from.

## How the family fits together

Product A collects data; Product B visualizes it. Both are documented
on their own sites, rendered separately, and published under this one.
